name: readable-vue-export
title: Export to Vue
description: Starter downstream export plugin for turning an accepted Readable Studio artifact into a Vue 3 single-file component handoff.

query.en: Export the accepted Readable Studio artifact to a Vue 3 single-file component. Preserve the visual system, use Composition API patterns where state is needed, and finish with integration notes.
query.zh-CN: 将已确认的 Readable Studio 产物导出为 Vue 3 单文件组件。保持视觉系统一致，在需要状态时使用 Composition API 模式，并在最后给出集成说明。
